content.text:
I changed `resolveGlobBase` in `packages/isomorphic/urlMatch.ts` so only the parts of a pattern that contain glob characters (`*`, `?`, `{`, `}`, `\`) are swapped for placeholders. Parts with none of those characters now go through URL resolution unchanged. I haven't built or run anything, and I didn't add tests.

With this, `http://localhost:80/**` resolves with the default port dropped, so it can match the request URL. Spaces become `%20`, and `münchen.de` becomes its punycode form. Parts with a `?` still use the existing placeholder handling, so the earlier fix for question marks in patterns is untouched.

The one rule I added is that a part with none of those characters is returned as is.
